transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to hold our staffing huddle for next Friday's professional-development day. As Director of HR, I'll be issuing the binding district staffing approval for the substitute roster, but per district coverage policy, I need each of you to review the rooms connected to your area of responsibility before we finalize assignments. We have four teachers out — Ms. Brooks in Algebra II, Mr. Chen in Biology Lab, Ms. Diaz in sixth-grade inclusion, and Ms. Ellis in Ceramics — and four approved substitutes available: Jordan Lee, Priya Shah, Morgan Reed, and Taylor Kim. Could each of you share any qualification or safety requirements for the rooms you oversee so we can match substitutes appropriately?
